brief: As the Halloway Hill 138/13kV transformer has ONAN cooling, the forced cooling instructions in MG-025 and MG-021 do not apply to it. According to MG-021, apply the ambient de-rating for accumulated heat above 30 degrees and sustained high load, and record every de-rating applied along with the reason, value, and period. Per SOP-013, if there is an open sampling defect within the remedial window before the forecast heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 until the work is complete and the retest returns within specification.
